description: Explicit allowlist of Avrotize CLI commands eligible for guarded, issue-requested reproduction. A command qualifies only when it is a local, deterministic, single-input schema transformation that performs no network or database discovery and never compiles or executes generated output. Every other command in avrotize/commands.json is blocked and requires manual maintainer reproduction.
authority_statement: This policy bounds what automation may execute. It does not authorize implementation, merge, release, or any repository mutation beyond governed reproduction state labels.

commands.description: Convert an Avrotize schema to JSON Schema.
commands.rationale: Pure in-process transformation of a single local file; no network, database, code generation, or compilation.

commands.description: Convert an Avrotize schema to an ASN.1 schema.
commands.rationale: Pure in-process transformation of a single local file; no network, database, code generation, or compilation.

commands.description: Convert a JSON Structure schema to an ASN.1 schema.
commands.rationale: Pure in-process transformation of a single local file; no network, database, code generation, or compilation.

commands.description: Emit the Parsing Canonical Form of an Avrotize schema on standard output.
commands.rationale: Pure in-process canonicalization of a single local file; writes only to standard output.

exclusions.reason: JSON Schema conversion dereferences remote $ref targets over HTTP, so reporter-supplied fixture data could drive outbound requests.
Generated projects would have to be compiled or executed to be meaningful, which guarded reproduction never does.
They perform network or database discovery against systems this automation must never contact.

exclusions.scope: every command not listed in this policy
exclusions.reason: Unlisted commands are blocked by default and require manual maintainer reproduction.
